title: Answer: cosmic consciousness, with every living organism one of its dissociated alters

statements.text: Only cosmic consciousness exists, so everything is in consciousness, but not everything is a separate subject: the perceivable cosmos is in consciousness rather than being conscious. Separate subjects with private phenomenal fields are living organisms, each a dissociated alter. That includes cats and dogs, and also plants and single-celled organisms such as amoebae, whose behavior is somewhat analogous to human behavior. No inanimate object is an alter, and robots or language interfaces engineered to simulate the behavior of living beings do not count.
statements.scope: the 2018 paper The universe in consciousness, the fullest statement of the view in this folder
